scope: mask-only independent review; no generated H&E was available or used

decisions.reason: Hard gates pass, but candidate 02 preserves source-relative nucleus count, nearest-neighbor spacing and Ripley clustering more closely with equivalent approved tissue geometry.
Both candidates pass the frozen gates. Candidate 02 provides the more source-like overall spatial distribution while retaining coherent significant immune regions and complete quota.
decisions.tissue_geometry: The 84,630-pixel joint change forms connected authorized stroma-to-immune regions; its 76,846-pixel tissue component preserves adjacent tumor and non-target structures.
decisions.nucleus_layout: The 118 class-2 nuclei are complete, non-overlapping and contained. Source-relative area-p95, count, NND and Ripley ratios are 0.809, 1.212, 0.961 and 1.078, improving count and clustering balance over candidate 01.
decisions.coupling: Added immune nuclei remain within the authorized transition; quota, seam, compatibility, spatial-distribution and local-density checks pass with sampling score 0.893.
decisions.preserved_conditions: Protected nuclei, prohibited regions and support-exterior instances remain unchanged without partial-instance, overlap, border or containment violations.
decisions.limitations: Target nuclei are smaller and more numerous than the source reference, although within the frozen envelope. Mask-only evidence does not establish generated-H&E quality or clinical validity.
decisions.verdict: Approve candidate 02 as the single mask-condition handoff.
